# Architecture Decision Record (ADR)

> A guide to architecture decision records: what they are, how to start using them, and a curated set of decision record templates and real-world examples. Source: https://github.com/architecture-decision-record/architecture-decision-record

## Guide

- [What is an architecture decision record?](https://architecture-decision-record.github.io/guide/what-is-an-architecture-decision-record/)
- [How to start using ADRs](https://architecture-decision-record.github.io/guide/how-to-start-using-adrs/)
- [How to start using ADRs with tools](https://architecture-decision-record.github.io/guide/how-to-start-using-adrs-with-tools/)
- [How to start using ADRs with git](https://architecture-decision-record.github.io/guide/how-to-start-using-adrs-with-git/)
- [Claude Code skills for ADRs](https://architecture-decision-record.github.io/guide/claude-code-skills-for-adrs/)
- [File name conventions for ADRs](https://architecture-decision-record.github.io/guide/file-name-conventions-for-adrs/)
- [Suggestions for writing good ADRs](https://architecture-decision-record.github.io/guide/suggestions-for-writing-good-adrs/)
- [ADR example templates](https://architecture-decision-record.github.io/guide/adr-example-templates/)
- [Teamwork advice for ADRs](https://architecture-decision-record.github.io/guide/teamwork-advice-for-adrs/)
- [Teamwork questions for ADRs](https://architecture-decision-record.github.io/guide/teamwork-questions-for-adrs/)
- [Next step concepts for ADRs](https://architecture-decision-record.github.io/guide/next-step-concepts-for-adrs/)
- [Architecture diagrams & views & viewpoints](https://architecture-decision-record.github.io/guide/architecture-diagrams-and-views-and-viewpoints/)
- [Fitness functions for decisions as code](https://architecture-decision-record.github.io/guide/fitness-functions-for-decisions-as-code/)
- [Decision guardrails for pull requests](https://architecture-decision-record.github.io/guide/decision-guardrails-for-pull-requests/)
- [For more information](https://architecture-decision-record.github.io/guide/for-more-information/)

## Templates

- [ADR template by Jeff Tyree and Art Akerman](https://architecture-decision-record.github.io/templates/decision-record-template-by-jeff-tyree-and-art-akerman/): more sophisticated
- [ADR template by Michael Nygard](https://architecture-decision-record.github.io/templates/decision-record-template-by-michael-nygard/): simple and popular
- [ADR template for Alexandrian pattern](https://architecture-decision-record.github.io/templates/decision-record-template-for-alexandrian-pattern/): simple with context specifics
- [ADR template for business case](https://architecture-decision-record.github.io/templates/decision-record-template-for-business-case/): more MBA-oriented, with costs, SWOT, and more opinions
- [ADR template of the Markdown Any Decision Records (MADR) project](https://architecture-decision-record.github.io/templates/decision-record-template-of-the-madr-project/): both simple and elaborate version; the latter emphasizes options and their pros and cons
- [ADR template using Planguage](https://architecture-decision-record.github.io/templates/decision-record-template-using-planguage/): more quality assurance oriented
- [Decision record template by arc42](https://architecture-decision-record.github.io/templates/decision-record-template-by-arc42/)
- [Decision record template by EdgeX](https://architecture-decision-record.github.io/templates/decision-record-template-by-edgex/)
- [Decision record template by Gareth Morgan](https://architecture-decision-record.github.io/templates/decision-record-template-by-gareth-morgan/)
- [Decision record template by GIG Cymru NHS Wales](https://architecture-decision-record.github.io/templates/decision-record-template-by-gig-cymru-nhs-wales/)
- [Template for Important Technical Decisions (ITDs) by Ignacio Larrañaga](https://architecture-decision-record.github.io/templates/decision-record-template-for-important-technical-decisions/): lean and decision-first, optimized for fast executive review
